notes.title: Share your thoughts on the recent demo!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We're intrigued to hear what you think about the demo - your feedback is of most importance, let us know more! What are your thoughts on characters and their design? We've put some time into this and tried to experiment a little bit this time, bringing some stylization to their looks. How do you feel about the stealth and gameplay overall? We decided to experiment a bit here too, so any feedback is appreciated! Work continues as we're now improving and finishing the game based on a feedback we've got, so don't be afraid to share yours too. 

[h1]Don't forget to wishlist the game![/h1]

Let's make this game incredible together!
